title: Choose the visual world for grimoire
question: The roll assigned the Pelican paperback system to the study view. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Pelican Library
options.lineage: Pelican Books, 'a library of self-education', with Penguin's subject-colour code and Tschichold's composition rules
options.thesis: Every item you study wears its subject colour, like a Pelican on the shelf: one study view, one cover grid.
options.viewport: Standard study shell: a colour band header in the item's primary-tag colour carrying back, title and source; a white middle band split into content (left) and NOTES.md (right, dominant) with the sandbox docked below; a matching colour footer band carrying autosave, toolchain and last-run state.
options.risk: If the band colours are timid or arbitrary it reads as a theme switcher; the subject code has to be consistent across list and study view.

raised.raise: Done, stopped and timed-out states stamp themselves onto the band and stay visible; nothing silently disappears.
Notes, sandbox and output are ruled modules with small tab heads on one hairline system, no cards or shadows.
Run history draws each run as a bar whose length is its real duration.
The open item's subject colour is the only saturated ink in the work band; every other tag stays quiet.

options.label: Engineer's Lab Notebook
options.lineage: bound, page-numbered engineering notebooks with dated, witnessed entries
options.thesis: Study as experiment: every note and run is a dated, numbered entry in the item's notebook.
options.viewport: Standard study shell with notes as dated entries down a numbered margin; sandbox runs log as entries with timestamp and exit code.
options.risk: Graph-paper notebooks are a common developer aesthetic, and the grid paper easily turns into a costume.

options.label: Jet-age Ticket Wallet
options.lineage: airline coupon books and baggage tags
options.thesis: The reading list as a coupon book; each item tears off when studied.
options.viewport: Study view as one coupon leg with fare boxes for source and tags.
options.case: Fuses poorly: studying isn't a journey to complete, and coupon boxes crowd the long-session work band.
options.kept: States stamp themselves on and stay visible; nothing disappears.

options.label: Japanese High-density Web
options.lineage: contemporary Japanese portal and retail sites
options.thesis: Pack every module onto one ruled mosaic.
options.viewport: Study view as a mosaic of ruled modules around the content.
options.case: Fuses poorly: hours of reading and writing need calm, not maximum density.
options.kept: One strict hairline module system with small tab heads.

options.label: Labanotation Score
options.thesis: Time runs upward; length is exact duration.
options.viewport: Notes and runs on a vertical time staff.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no audience identification, and a staff obscures Markdown source.
options.risk: Opaque to anyone who can't read the score.

options.label: Midnight Transit Diagram
options.thesis: Tags as coloured lines, items as stations.
options.viewport: Study view under a line strip showing where the item sits among its tags.
options.case: Fuses partly on audience, but the map belongs to the reading list, not the study view, and the dark enamel fights long reading.
options.risk: A map with nowhere to travel in this surface.
options.kept: The chosen line burns brightest; everything else stays quiet.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: One subject at fixed scale through its stages.
options.case: Fuses poorly: lands on the cream-and-serif default and has no task fit.
options.kept: All panes share one baseline grid.

options.label: Variable Type Specimen
options.viewport: Item title set huge over notes.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a specimen is a display, not a workspace.
options.kept: No ornament; type scale carries hierarchy.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A notes-and-code app the way Obsidian or VS Code would ship it, at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Dark neutral split view with tabs over notes and sandbox and one accent colour.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the tools it sits beside, by design.
